outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Redesign Ball VS Space's Inventory as a HIGH-QUALITY, VERY CRISP, MULTICOLOR ROBLOX STUD UI. The user's latest correction is essential: stud interfaces have much sharper defined edges on EVERYTHING and LOTS OF COLORS. Make a substantial visual change, not a blue theme with a few colored accents.

INPUTS:
Image 1 is the user's new PRIMARY STYLE reference: the small "Daily Rewards" menu with hot-pink header, sharp rectangular multicolored tiles, fine repeating studs, hard black borders, vivid sunbursts and bright green buttons. Follow those traits. It is low-resolution but the output must be high-resolution and clean. Do not use its reward/days/claim text or invent rewards.
Image 2 is the actual Inventory screenshot, CONTENT ONLY: preserve category tabs, 3-column ball grid and selected-item details.
Image 3 is the canonical original ball atlas.
Image 4 is the original icon atlas.

OUTPUT:
One polished front-facing desktop game menu screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape. Window fills about 92% of frame, existing blue Roblox lobby softly dimmed behind it. UI itself is exceptionally SHARP, like precision-drawn native GUI, with no blur, glow, fog, soft lighting, fluffy silhouettes or inflated rounded controls.
Use square corners, 0–2px radius. Consistent hard 3px black outlines, 1px light inner keylines and small flat 2px bottom/right shadow strips. Crisp antialiasing, not pixel art. Fine small square studs in regular straight rows, low relief, 1px highlight/shadow, not large soft plastic knobs. Broad saturated color fills and very restrained straight gradients. No photoreal material or large 3D bevels.

PALETTE AND HIERARCHY:
Graphite structural frame with thin gaps. HOT MAGENTA studded header. Each category tab and item card is a different vivid color, like the user's reference. Colors are decorative, NOT rarity. Full colored card faces, not all-navy cards with colored rims. Small bright lime action controls, dark outlined white rounded game labels. Clean alignment, substantial readable names, restrained text shadow. Compact header and tabs, no enormous title.

HEADER: "Inventory", small original cube icon, subtitle "12 ball appearances". A small square orange-red X close button at top right, crisp black outline.
TABS: "Balls" gold-yellow, "Explosions" violet, "Flyers" turquoise, "Fusion" royal blue. Small existing icons and bold white dark-outlined text. Active Balls indicated by an extra thin white inner rectangle, not glow. Equal tab sizes.

BODY:
Left roughly 66% is a 3-column x 2-row visible collection grid with a narrow square-edged scrollbar. Right roughly 31% is the selected item detail, aligned with the grid.
Six equally sized rectangular cards with vivid colored surfaces and very subtle angular sunburst behind art. Fine embossed square studs around edges and name strip. Existing art has clean original silhouettes and ordinary original shading, no new effects.
Row 1:
"Verity Ball": yellow smiling ball on a CYAN card, small solid green check badge "Equipped".
"Axe Ball": slate sphere with orange stripe plus the actual axe, on an ORANGE card. Selected with a precise WHITE inner outline and a small cyan corner marker, no glowing rim.
"Poison Spike Ball": smooth lime ball on a PURPLE card.
Row 2:
"Burst Ball": orange plus sphere on a BLUE card.
"Cell Ball": pale green concentric sphere on a CORAL PINK card.
"Vampire Ball": red sphere with white fangs on a LIME GREEN card.
Leave clear space around sprites. Give each card a dedicated readable name band using a slightly darker version of its color. No rarity labels, stats or ownership counts.

DETAIL PANEL:
Warm GOLD/AMBER studded rectangular panel, clean black border and 1px inner highlight. Small cyan label "SELECTED", title "Axe Ball". A large sharply bounded orange/gold sunburst preview area containing the original axe ball. Small quiet label "Anchor kit".
Exact description: "Spins an axe, widening its territory." Easy-to-read dark text on a lighter golden area, not microscopic.
Separate line "Equipped: Verity".
Large rectangular BRIGHT GREEN "Equip" button at bottom with fine studs, a black outline, white dark-outlined text, and a crisp dark-green bottom edge. Same sharp button language as the user's example.

Keep UI high-quality and coherent despite its many colors: uniform outline scale, square corners, matching stud size, consistent padding and strong white/black typography. This is Roblox's colorful stud style, NOT neon science fiction, glossy mobile-game plastic, a blue monochrome panel, or soft 3D framing. No prices, purchasing, daily reward mechanics, rarity, new ball designs or extra controls. No signature, watermark or annotations. Preserve correct selected Axe versus equipped Verity state.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create the matching STORE screen for Ball VS Space's latest CRISP MULTICOLOR STUD Inventory. The user explicitly wants sharply defined edges throughout and LOTS OF COLORS, as in their Daily Rewards example.
One complete front-facing 1536x1024 desktop game menu, native-looking Roblox ScreenGui.

INPUTS:
Image 1: user's primary reference, sharp rectangular Daily Rewards interface. Use its crisp black lines, fine square studs, saturated multicolor tiles, bright green action buttons. Do not copy any day/reward mechanics or text.
Image 2: latest Inventory redesign. Match this exact crisp outline treatment, MAGENTA stud header, squared geometry, multicolor tiles, simple sprite rendering, type scale and backdrop.
Image 3: existing Store screenshot, CONTENT/INTERACTION ONLY.
Image 4: original ball art.
Image 5: original icon art.

STYLE:
Strong clean 3px black outlines, 1px bright inner keylines, hard 2px bottom/right shadow strips, square 0–2px-radius corners. NO pill buttons, soft inflated bevels, bloom, glows or fuzzy outlines. Studs are small sharp square relief marks, in regular rows, uniformly lit. Saturated colored full surfaces, NOT navy with colored accents. Angular sunburst item wells. Clear typography in bold rounded white with crisp black outlines; supporting text in clean high-contrast panels. High-resolution polished precision, not pixel art. Narrow dim blue Roblox lobby behind the window.

LAYOUT:
Use similar window size and alignment as image 2, around 92% width and 90% height.
Header is HOT MAGENTA studded band. Small existing store-machine icon and "Store" at left. Smaller "Explore the collection". Right: compact rectangular yellow coin panel displaying "0", cyan gem panel displaying "0", then a small orange-red square white X. No plus controls.
Four colored category tabs: "Events" cyan, "Balls" gold yellow, "Explosions" purple, "Flyers" coral pink. Small existing icons, sharp black border and fine inner highlights. Events active with a thin white inner rectangle.
Graphite content separators and spacing. Heading "Collection picks" with compact yellow "Free collection" badge.
Four equal RECTANGULAR product cards:
1 "Laser Ball": existing purple sphere on a saturated CYAN sunburst/stud background; green "View Ball" button.
2 "Ray Ball": original orange sphere with pale yellow band and disk on a PURPLE sunburst/stud background; green "View Ball".
3 "Colorful Balloon": original multicolor balloon cluster and red bow on an ORANGE sunburst/stud background; yellow "Preview".
4 "Blue Parasol": original blue/cyan umbrella on a CORAL PINK sunburst/stud background; yellow "Preview".
Names on dedicated darker color-matched bands; generous art space and readable labels. All four align and share identical border, corner and stud dimensions. Button faces are sharply outlined stud plates with thin darker lower edge. No rare/common/epic labels; colors are decorative.

Bottom feature: bright BLUE and TURQUOISE studded banner with controlled angular rays. Left text: "COLLECTION SPOTLIGHT", large "Find your next favorite", then "12 ball appearances · All free". Right: existing Laser, Ray and Orbit balls arranged neatly, separated from text. No additional call to action or new items.
Footer exact: "All ball appearances are free. No purchase needed."

The result must be energetic, precise, and very colorful, matching the new Inventory. Preserve existing view/preview behavior and assets; no prices, purchasing, stock, rarity, daily rewards, timers, gacha, new capabilities or gameplay stats. No watermark, signature or annotations.

checks: Sharper and more colorful treatment than stud-v1
limits: Generated concepts, not live Roblox screenshots.
Canonical sprites are references; generated outlines and appearance adjustments are proposals, not replacement runtime artwork.
Card colors are decorative and do not indicate rarity.
Desktop only; responsive phone design and user acceptance remain pending.

implementation: No game source changes or new runtime tests; workflow benchmark has not started.
